verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only external AI tooling: an MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, agent skills, docs-as-markdown, and llms.txt. Nothing shows an AI assistant built into the Appwrite Console that writes queries, debugs errors, or explains the backend. Those external-agent integrations are adjacent features, not the in-dashboard assistant the story asks for, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an AI assistant in the dashboard to write queries, debug errors, and explain my backend
